WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE K.NATARAJAN  ORAL ORDER Crl.P.No.7880/2023 is filed by accused Nos.9 and 19 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the criminal proceedings in CC No.29575/2022 arising out of crime No.453/2022 registered by Whitefield CEN Police Station, Bengaluru and charge sheeted for offences punishable under Sections 120B, 149, 419, 201 and Section 420 of NC: 2024:KHC:32571 IPC and Sections 66, 66(C),
66(D) of Information Technology Act, 2000.
2.

Crl.P.No.7948/2023 is also filed against the same petitioners, where they are arrayed as accused Nos.12 and 19 in the charge sheet in CC No.29573/2022 arising out of Crime No.454/2022 registered by Whitefield CEN Police, Bengaluru and charge sheeted for the similar offences.

3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and Addl. SPP for the State and perused the records.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioners contends that the police have filed 2 false complaints against the petitioner company within a span of half an hour.
Some of the accused persons had already approached this Court and they were acquitted in Crl.P.No.8975/2022 connected with Crl.P.No.8708/2022 and the same was upheld by the hon'ble Supreme Court.
It is contended that the one of the petitioners is a car driver and another one is said to be an investor.

There is no document produced by the State or the Police to show that they are the directors of the company or Mr Dudhat Ketan Vittahalbhi vs State By Karnataka on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126281738/
3 they are the team leaders.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, NC: 2024:KHC:32571 continuation of the criminal proceedings against them would amount to abuse of process of law.
Hence, he prays for quashing allowing this petition.
5. Per contra, Addl. SPP has seriously objected the petition contending that the petitioners are the team leaders by the name 'Vicky Team'.

They had collected huge money from the public as investment and cheated them and allegations made against the petitioners in Crl.P.No.8975/2022 connected with Crl.P.No.8708/2022 are different from these petitioners in the present cases, since,
these petitioners were absconding and they were not present before the Court.
The charge sheet is filed after considering the documents produced by the Investigating Officer.
Hence, she prays to dismiss this petition.

6. Heard the arguments and perused the records.
7.

The allegation against the petitioners is that accused No.1 is said to be a fake company running a call centre namely 'Ethical Infotech Pvt. Ltd.' at Whitefield and 'Ethical Infocom Pvt. Ltd.' At Mahadevapura.
They had NC: 2024:KHC:32571 employed various persons and used to call citizens from United States stating that they have won gift from Amazon and used to ask them to go and collect the gift.
To accept or reject the gift, the customers had to give the one time password and after obtaining the one time password, the accused used to draw the amount from the account of the customers.

Therefore, a complaint came to be registered and this Court after hearing the arguments,
allowed the petitions in Crl.P.No.8975/2022 connected with Crl.P.No.8708/2022 in respect of the accused Nos.1, 8, 16 and 1, 7, 6, 11.
The case of the present petitioners is similar to both of those cases.
Though, Addl. SPP have argued that they petitioners are the team leaders, they have not produced any documents to show that these two persons are running the company as director or as team leaders.
Nothing is forthcoming in the charge sheet to show that the petitioners are in-charge of the alleged company.
Therefore, this Court has contended in the earlier orders that there is no complaint made by the public, who have been actually cheated by these NC: 2024:KHC:32571 petitioners.
Merely, because some mobile phones were seized from the place of occurrence, that does not constitute the alleged offences against the petitioners.
There is no complaint and no victim and no documentary evidence.
Such being the case, this Court has quashed the criminal proceedings against the co-accused persons.
8. Even in the both present cases the petitioners are alleged to be directors or team leaders of accused company.
But, no documentary evidence is forthcoming.
There must be some material evidence to show that the petitioners have cheated the customers.
Apart from that, the order of this Court quashing the criminal proceedings against the co-accused persons is upheld by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in SLP No.31312/2023.
Thereby, the order of this Court has attained finality for quashing the criminal proceedings.
Hence, there is no reason for taking any different view to quash the criminal proceedings in these matters.
The State has also failed to show that the allegation against the present petitioners is different from the petitioners in Crl.P.No.8975/2022 connected with NC: 2024:KHC:32571 Crl.P.No.8708/2022.
Therefore, I am of the considered opinion that this Court has already looked into the matter and quashed the criminal proceedings against the co- accused persons.

Accordingly, the following order:
